ModMetaData.name: Compatibility Ratkin Anomaly+ and Void Universe Patch
ModMetaData.author: Keullaeseu
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes the InvalidProgram crash in Ratkin Anomaly+ (Background_PatchMain Transpiler on MainTabWindow_Research.DrawRightRect) and extends vanilla Anomaly research-tab handling (background, ViewSize, DrawProjectInfo) to the Ratkin tab (RA_Tab) and the Void Universe tab (UV_Anomaly).
How it works: on startup it neutralizes Ratkin's index-based transpilers on MainTabWindow_Research (DrawRightRect, ViewSize, DrawProjectInfo) before Ratkin's own PatchAll can throw, then applies pattern-based replacements that generalize the vanilla "CurTab == Anomaly" checks to Anomaly + RA_Tab + UV_Anomaly without touching branch targets or locals. Safe to run alongside Anomalies Expected, which patches the same research methods first (its checks are detected and left as-is).
Requires: Harmony, Ratkin Anomaly+, Dlc collaboration - Void universe, Anomaly DLC. Load after both mods.
